purpose: Per-kind app handlers on the history-sink path: kind-9 chat, kind-7 reaction and kind-5 delete/edit take {groupId,eventId,rumor,sender} (sender = MLS-authenticated account, never rumor.pubkey), dispatch idempotently with store bumps driven from handler completion, confirm own echoes by rumor.id without unread/bell, and retract withdrawn rumors while keeping effects already emitted. groupRumorDispatch.ts composes them into the sink's GroupHistoryHandlers and routes group notifications to member/admin/name/disband resync only.

public_api.name: createGroupRumorDispatch
public_api.signature: (options: { handlers: readonly GroupKindHandler[]; env: GroupHandlerEnv }) => GroupHistoryHandlers
public_api.description: dispatch/retract routed by rumor.kind; throws at construction for a handler kind outside APP_RUMOR_KINDS; handler failures propagate (sink keeps the row undispatched).

public_api.name: GroupKindHandler
public_api.signature: { kind: number; dispatch(input: GroupRumorInput, env: GroupHandlerEnv): Promise<void>; retract(input: GroupRumorInput, env: GroupHandlerEnv): Promise<void> }
public_api.description: One app kind on the sink path.

public_api.name: toHandlerArgs
public_api.signature: (input: GroupRumorInput, env: GroupHandlerEnv) => { ctx: DispatcherContext; sender: AuthenticatedSender }

public_api.name: createGroupNotificationRouter
public_api.description: onGroupNotification routing: members/admins/name/disband only; message and message-withdrawn are ignored (D13).

public_api.name: createChatGroupHandler
public_api.description: kind 9 incl. edit-marked replacements and announcements; own echo confirm; known-peer remember; retract removes another member's row + recompute unread, hands own row to onOwnWithdrawn.

public_api.name: createReactionGroupHandler
public_api.description: kind 7; tolerates a missing target; retract via retractReaction port.

public_api.name: chatPersistence.removeMessages
public_api.description: Now resolves the number of rows removed (no longer called by the S4 handlers; retract goes through retractMessageCarrier).

public_api.name: chatPersistence.appendOrAddCarrier
public_api.signature: (groupId: string, message: ChatMessage, eventId: string) => Promise<'inserted' | 'duplicate'>
public_api.description: Sink-path delivery write: insert-if-absent OR add eventId as a carrier of the existing row, inside ONE serialised per-group queue task (atomic against a concurrent retractMessageCarrier).

public_api.name: chatPersistence.retractMessageCarrier / hasMessage
public_api.signature: (groupId, rumorId, eventId, sender) => Promise<number>; (groupId, id) => Promise<boolean>
public_api.description: Withdraw one carrier; the row goes only when its last carrier is withdrawn and the stored sender matches. hasMessage backs the own-retract 'never applied' check.

public_api.name: handlers/types.ts
public_api.description: Handler contract types, moved out of applicationRumorDispatcher (re-exported there for legacy users) so S22 can delete that module without touching handlers.

external_ports: ChatGroupHandlerDeps (appendOrAddCarrier, retractMessageCarrier, hasMessage, recomputeUnread, rememberKnownPeer, onOwnEcho, onOwnWithdrawn, retractDeleteEditSignal; every required port is checked at construction, TypeError naming it)
test_targets: app/tsconfig.tests-marmot.json (type-checks the epic's test files; run by make test-unit)
